Also: `median_metres` is the boundary sample step (~21 m), NOT edge length - summing it understated a 42.8 km route as 10.1 km. The router uses centre-to-centre haversine instead.

Phase 2. rider_dna skill is peak lean PER CORNER (p95 30.2 deg); cell demand_p90 is the p90 over every sample in a cell, straights included (median 7.4 deg). Subtracting one from the other gives z = -3 network-wide and flow collapses to 0 on all 21,130 cells. calibrate_rider reads skill off the same demand_p90 column the challenge comes from, over the 360-586 cells the rider actually rode. Uses the MEDIAN, so z*=0 means the habitual road.
